subject: Spontaneous application – Data Engineering Internship at Veolia
body:
Dear Hiring Manager,

I am reaching out with a spontaneous application for a Data Engineering internship at Veolia (Paris). Currently a Master’s student in computer science, I have practical experience with Python and SQL from a prior development internship and I am motivated to contribute to data initiatives that support environmental services. Please find my CV and cover letter attached.

Thank you for your consideration,
John Doe
+33 6 00 00 00 00
john@example.com

letter.name: John Doe
letter.subject: Spontaneous application – Data Engineering Internship
body: I am writing to express my interest in a Data Engineering internship at Veolia in Paris. Motivated by the challenges of managing and leveraging data to support environmental services, I am submitting a spontaneous application.

Currently pursuing a Master en informatique (2024–2026) at Université Exemple, I strengthened my skills in Python and SQL during a development internship in 2025 at Entreprise Exemple (scripts in Python, database queries). I am eager to contribute to the creation of reliable datasets and data flows and to apply rigorous practices in Linux environments.
I would welcome the opportunity to discuss how my skills in Python, SQL and Linux could support your data engineering initiatives.

cv.name: John Doe
cv.headline: Étudiant en informatique – stage en Data Engineering
cv.summary: Étudiant intéressé par l'ingénierie des données, souhaitant effectuer un stage en Data Engineering chez Veolia. Compétences pratiques en Python, SQL et Linux, développées lors d'un stage de développement.
